user_request: Independent Merlin web app inspired by ChatGPT, Grok/OpenBot and Claude; downward-sloping ASCII Merlin coin animation; GUI animations from actual data; retain SSD/Parallax work.
decision: Extend the existing local Studio and durable registry with genuine model SSE and authenticated replay, preserving offline deployment and existing tool authority.

initial_frame.baseline: Whole model responses and 800ms UI polling
observable_targets: First text arrives before upstream generation finishes
Cancellation releases a blocked upstream read
Reconnection does not resubmit a model request
Recorded event identity determines invocation animation
Chart values derive from actual UTF-8 text bytes and timestamps
Original extracted-package answer acceptance remains unchanged
unknowns: Final combined CI and actual packaged model stream

implementation: Incremental bounded upstream SSE parser and complete-tool validation
Durable text_delta/model_response events with SQLite ordinal replay cursors
Responsive Studio identity, downward-sloping ASCII coin spin and reduced-motion support
Event-derived activity metrics and cumulative output chart
DOM-only Markdown rendering and event-backed partial responses
Pinned Qwen2.5-1.5B full Linux candidate; separate real streaming receipt after unchanged native gate

evidence.kind: actual loopback TCP with synthetic model output
actual Node renderer and event-state function contracts
independent async frontend stream contract review
evidence.scope: same and new approval snapshots, following delta, stale generation

evidence.fixture_repair: Preserved one observed post-flush scheduling assertion failure; wait boundedly for the server notification while retaining the text-before-finish condition.

evidence.kind: actual offline file read and browser replay
evidence.preview_playback_timing: Slowed per-event playback; original measurement timestamps retained

recovery.workspace: Earlier scratch snapshot restored after interruption
recovery.action: Recover matching source where hashes can be verified; label reconstructed source and rerun pinned model in a separate recovery lane; never recreate old receipts from summaries.

simplex.reason: No convex resource allocation is required for deterministic UI transport.

n_ality.reason: Generation, tool execution, durable storage, transport and presentation are separate state axes; UI similarity grants no model or tool authority.
n_ality.test: Cancellation, replay and partial-tool boundaries checked independently.

continuum.reason: Visual rotation and between-frame transitions are display interpolation only.
continuum.invariant: Displayed measurements and timestamps remain observed; no simulated telemetry is labeled live.

fuzzy_logic.reason: Provider availability, authorization, integrity and acceptance remain Boolean.

bias_controls.risk: UI similarity mistaken for model-quality parity
bias_controls.countermeasure: Concrete capability matrix and actual-provider qualification

bias_controls.risk: Invented utilization or progress presented as observation
bias_controls.countermeasure: Only recorded events, bytes and timestamps populate metrics

bias_controls.risk: Summary numbers relabeled as current verification
bias_controls.countermeasure: Preserve published baseline and fresh acquisition/run receipts
